describe: The image shows a bright, warm-toned surface in cream, pale yellow and light amber with a soft, painterly, slightly blotchy texture. Faint darker tan blotches and streaks are scattered across the upper half, and a dark rust-brown band fills the bottom third with a curved edge. Brightness is high in the centre and contrast is moderate. Fully opaque, no transparent areas; the pattern looks roughly symmetrical top to bottom.
